question:
In this question, statement I and statement II are given. These statements may be independent causes, effects of independent causes, or a common cause. One of these statements may be an effect of the other. Read both statements carefully and choose the correct answer.

I. The water level of the local river has reached its lowest level so far this summer, disrupting water supply to nearby towns.

II. Several power plants in the region have reported reduced power generation due to insufficient water for cooling processes.

options.text: Both I and II are independent causes.
II is the cause and I is its possible effect.
Both I and II are effects of independent causes.
I is the cause and II is its possible effect.
